mapper.select: select id, code, name, status, sort, remark from sys_role order by sort asc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_role(id, code, name, status, sort, remark) values (#{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{status}, #{sort}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update sys_role set code = #{code}, name = #{name}, status = #{status}, sort = #{sort}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id}
